title: ai.agenticorg.payment.upi_mandate checkout extension (2026-10-20)
description: UCP vendor extension of dev.ucp.shopping.checkout that declares the Action type ai.agenticorg.payment.upi_mandate_authorization. A merchant emits the Action while a UPI AutoPay instrument needs the RBI additional factor of authentication (the buyer authorises the e-mandate with the UPI PIN at the url). The step is the buyer's own, out of band: the checkout stays incomplete until the provider confirms the mandate, and nothing on the merchant side waits for it. The mandate terms are the ones the buyer registers; amounts are integer minor units.

upi_mandate_authorization.description: One outstanding mandate authorisation (UCP Action instance: id and config).

id.description: Stable for the same outstanding step; different terms are new work with a new id.

payment_instrument_id.description: The UPI AutoPay instrument of the checkout the mandate is for.

url.description: Where the buyer authorises the mandate.

mandate_reference.description: The merchant's mandate reference the provider confirms.

mandate_terms.description: The e-mandate the buyer registers: amount rule and limit, frequency, validity and purpose.
